purpose: Domain 7 (social cognition): facial emotion recognition, intensity, and social-perception games. Synthetic identities = no real person's likeness, no consent burden, commercial-safe. Every image must pass the rater validation in THL-RES-002 before status becomes 'approved'.
base_prompt: Passport-style colour photograph of a real {age}-year-old {region} {sex}, {skin} skin, {hair}, wearing a plain {top}, looking straight at the camera, head and shoulders, plain light grey background, soft even studio light, neutral relaxed expression, mouth closed, photorealistic, natural skin texture, no makeup look, no jewellery except small studs
expression_prompt: Change only the facial expression to {expression}, at {intensity} intensity. Keep the same person, identity, hair, clothes, lighting, camera angle and background exactly the same.

expressions.sad: sadness: inner eyebrows raised, lip corners down
expressions.angry: anger: lowered drawn-together eyebrows, tense lips pressed together
expressions.fear: fear: eyebrows raised and drawn together, upper eyelids raised, lips stretched
expressions.surprise: surprise: eyebrows raised high, eyes wide open, jaw dropped open
expressions.disgust: disgust: nose wrinkled, upper lip raised

identities.hair: black hair with grey strands in a bun
